metadata.title: When you don’t even know what you clicked but enemy just vanished LOL
metadata.description:
That moment you realize your aim took a coffee break.
Enemy probably uninstalling to save dignity.
Click if your kills are mostly ‘how did that happen?’ moments.

Watch me fake confidence while luck does the work!

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but the kills keep coming!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
